hints.title: Single Odd Frequency Constraint for Symmetry
hints.text: A string can form palindromes only if at most one character occurs an odd number of times, which must serve as the central pivot.

hints.title: Permuting Symmetrical Half Characters
hints.text: Form a multiset containing half the counts of each character. Generating unique permutations of this half creates all possible palindromes by mirror reflection.

hints.title: Backtracking Half-Strings with Skip on Duplicate
hints.text: Sort the half characters. Backtrack through distinct permutations using a boolean visited list and skipping identical adjacent unused characters. For each valid half, construct half plus central char plus reversed half.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution generating each unique palindrome directly in O((N/2)!) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Permuting the entire string of length N takes O(N!) time and generates many non-palindromic duplicates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Permuting only half the characters cuts factorial branching by half and guarantees palindrome symmetry.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle duplicate character permutations correctly to avoid redundant results.
